errors.text: The intervention is generic property-prediction machine learning rather than the coupled replacement of EAM by an MTP and thermodynamic integration by free-energy perturbation.
The proposed 500–2000 K range excludes the target 2000–2400 K regime and is not justified.
No supporting prior evidence or citations are supplied.
The hypothesis omits the TaVCrW BCC alloy, 0 GPa condition, GGA-PBE/LDA comparison, supercell scale, and required MTP accuracy.
It provides no quantitative predictions for computational savings, free-energy agreement, melting-point shifts, electronic excitations, or short-range-order stabilization.
